title: Clearing a delivery without blocking the door
target: How to handle the boxes a delivery leaves in Supermarket Simulator: carrying them by their target, letting the game sort them, taking from them and merging them, and keeping the cells and the shop floor in mind.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A moment before the next customer

steps.do: Carry a box in rather than dragging it about, because carrying has a target of its own.
steps.because: carrying a box uses a target, with an interface for things that can be a box's target (CarryBoxTarget, IBoxTarget)

steps.do: Put a box down where boxes belong and let the game sort it, because boxes are sortable objects with a manager behind them.
steps.because: boxes are sortable objects kept by a manager of their own (SortableBox, SortableBoxManager)

steps.do: Open a box where you need it, knowing that taking is an action with an answer rather than a guess.
steps.because: taking from a box has its own action and returns a result (TakeBox, TakeBoxResult)

steps.do: Merge part-used boxes instead of keeping two half boxes side by side.
steps.because: there is a control for merging boxes (BoxMergeControl)

steps.do: Let the cells decide what fits, because a box is divided into cells laid out on a grid.
steps.because: a box has cells, laid out on a grid of its own (BoxCell, BoxGridLayout3D)

steps.do: Keep the kind of box in mind, because a freezer box and a greengrocer's box are not the same thing to the game.
steps.because: a box has a definition of its own (BoxSO)

steps.do: Dress a shop with dummy boxes when stock is short, rather than leaving shelves bare.
steps.because: the game can generate dummy boxes to dress a shop (DummyBoxGenerator)

steps.do: Expect treats in a box of their own, so the ice cream counter is cleared like any other.
steps.because: ice cream has a box kind of its own (IceCreamBucketBox)

steps.do: Clear the floor before the next delivery rather than letting boxes pile up, because what is in the back room is kept in the manager's lists.
steps.because: every kind of box is kept in the manager's own lists (SortableBoxManager, BoxCell)

commonMistakes: Dragging a box around instead of carrying it by its target.
Leaving two half boxes on the floor when they could be merged.
Putting a freezer box where a greengrocer's box belongs, expecting the game to sort it out.
Opening a box and walking away without checking what came out.
Letting the next delivery arrive into a floor that is still full.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Identifiers are listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
